text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mozambique's state housing company has raised rents by more than 40 percent, in an effort to persuade tenants to buy their houses. But the highest monthly rent will be the equivalent of $31.
- Private schools admitted 37,500 pupils last year, about two percent of the number admitted to state schools, the Education Ministry said.
